# ue-render-profiles-toolset

> Versioned Unreal Engine render profiles (CVars and scalability): a pure core with profile resolution, catalog validation, diff, apply and revert plans, and a thin Unreal adapter. Python package `trysac-ue-render-profiles-toolset`, import name `ue_render_profiles_toolset`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.11, no runtime dependencies. Nothing was tested inside Unreal; the adapter was tested against a fake console.
